connector.name: Suitecrm MCP
connector.registryDescription: Open-source MCP gateway for SuiteCRM - 24 CRM tools, OAuth2/OIDC auth, multi-entity, observability.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package suitecrm-mcp-gateway. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the anirudhx7 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token - personal API key issued by the gateway after OAuth2/OIDC login
